paragraphs: R' Simlai, son of Rav Ulla.
Otzar Yisrael cites him from Yalkut Isaiah 393, but Hyman says, “I did not find it.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: שצג has numeral value 393; no specific remez scheme, Yalkut Shimoni identification, edition or author is verified. The work title Otzar Yisrael is retained without naming the unstated citer.
The negative I-did-not-find observation belongs to Hyman, not a new search by this reviewer. Son-of relation remains; the father’s Rav is full and the son’s title remains R'.
